orientationRingSamples.description: Maximum accepted IMU probes retained before a face move consumes the ring.

rotationDropThresholdDegrees.description: Sample-to-sample angular rotation, in degrees, that starts an exclusion region.

rotationDropFollowingSamples.description: Subsequent IMU probes rejected after a threshold-crossing sample.

correctionErrorDivisor.description: Remaining orientation error is divided by this value to obtain the display-only correction for each accepted face move. A value of 5 turns a 5° error into a 1° correction.

maximumTargetErrorDegrees.description: When a face move's ring just recovered from a rotation-drop exclusion window and the display is still off by more than this many degrees, CubeLab snaps the display to the nearest of the cube's 24 legal poses instead of grinding toward the old target over many moves. Every legal pose is 90° from its neighbours, so the resulting jump is always bounded (about 63° worst case) and always lands on a clean orientation.
